items.q: Derbie Davie Wilson, you know -- he's the discoverer of Pearl Bailey's tap dancing brother

ctx.x: And they came up on stage, see. At that time I was still -- the show had changed, see. I had -- me and Bojangles
Robinson's real protege in real life, Derbie Davie Wilson, you know -- he's the discoverer of Pearl Bailey's tap dancing brother, the minister's son, Bill Bailey.
Did the show change its name when it moved to the Mercury Theater?
